Subject: Important: Workplace Conduct and Professional Standards

Dear [Employee Name],

I am writing to address some recent concerns regarding your workplace behavior. We have received multiple complaints indicating that your conduct has not aligned with our company’s core values.

It is essential that all team members uphold a professional and respectful environment. We expect an immediate and sustained improvement in your behavior to ensure it meets our professional standards.

Please take this matter seriously and make the necessary adjustments promptly. If you have any questions or need support in addressing these issues, please do not hesitate to reach out to me or HR.

Thank you for your attention to this important matter.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]

***

**Priority Question Answer:**
The animal known for its long neck is the **giraffe**.
